page.overview:
Who is Blowfish?

Blowfish is a character in Mario Party 3.

Blowfish is a giant anglerfish with an arrow at the end of its fin ray.

The Blowfish is found in the board Deep Bloober Sea. When a player lands on a Happening Space near the anglerfish, the arrow on its fin ray points to the bottom, front, or right of the board. The anglerfish then inhales all players in front of it like a vacuum. To avoid being sucked into Blowfish, players must press repeatedly to escape the suction. Players that fail are sucked into the anglerfish, then spat out in the direction the arrow fin points towards, landing them at the start, near a pink Sushi, or near a Boo.
